items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: So we asked Joe Hubert to come and join our show

ctx.x: We left Memphis and went to Virginia. I'm not saying that that's the manner in which it was done or whether that's the time, but . We went to Danville, Virginia, and we had this show and a man by the name of Boisse DeLegge had , came into town at the same time we were there. So people used to just try to steal...not steal...but entice people from one show to the other. So the show that we were on needed three more people to go...well, four people...to go into Danville, Virginia. So we...there was a guy named…
have it they didn't give it to you. So we asked Joe Hubert to come and join our show and leave Boisse DeLegge and come with Happy Donovan and Travis Tucker. He said all right, he'd do it.

Well, somehow Boisse DeLegge found out that Joe was going to leave the show. So Joe was trying to hide around to keep him from catching up with him. So finally he caught up with Joe and Boise was, you know, from New Orleans, and with a hot temper, and so he belted Joe one right in the eye. Well, Joe was ready to stay with the show, you know but naturally ...people agitating, he said, 'Well, you haven't paid me for the last eight weeks,' and that was the only way he could get away from the show, because the guy…
